title: VIE intensity object (region record)
description: vie.intensity-object/1 — one level-uniform 4-connected region of a quantized intensity map (VIE-SPEC-REP 1.1.0 §R2/§R3). `bbox` is the half-open integer box [x0,y0,x1,y1); `centroid` is (cx,cy) over pixel centers; `fingerprint` is a content signature, NOT a cross-frame identity (Phase 3 owns tracking identity).

bbox.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1) — half-open, x right, y down (VIE-SPEC-REP 1.0.0 §6, 1.1.0 §R3)

centroid.description: [cx, cy] arithmetic mean of pixel centers, float64
